info.title: NaccsPDFIndex
info.description: CLI tool to index and search NACCS portal PDF output codes

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
naccs-pdf-index — NACCS portal PDF output code indexer

Commands:
  init    Crawl the NACCS portal sitemap and build/update the local SQLite index
  search  Search the index by code, page title, or output info name (情報名称)
  errors  Show or retry PDFs that failed during indexing

Examples:
  naccs-pdf-index init
  naccs-pdf-index init --force
  naccs-pdf-index init --parallelism 7  (or -p 7)
  naccs-pdf-index search SAF004
  naccs-pdf-index search SAF004 --group
  naccs-pdf-index search "輸入 申告" --title
  naccs-pdf-index search "内国貨物" --name
  naccs-pdf-index errors
  naccs-pdf-index errors --retry

commands.name: init
commands.description: Crawl the NACCS portal sitemap and build/update the local SQLite index. Resumes automatically if interrupted.

options.name: --force
options.description: Re-index all PDFs, ignoring etag/last-modified cache. Also clears the error log.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Number of concurrent page workers (1–7, default 7). Alias: -p

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the index by code prefix, page title, or output info name (情報名称)

options.name: --json
options.description: Output results as JSON instead of a table

options.name: --title
options.description: Search page titles with fuzzy multi-word match (e.g. "輸入 申告" matches titles containing both words)

options.name: --name
options.description: Search output info names 情報名称 (e.g. '内国貨物運送')

options.name: --group
options.description: Deduplicate code results by code+PDF — one row per unique code, columns: Code | Message Name | PDF

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search term: code prefix (e.g. SAF004), title keywords, or info name

commands.name: errors
commands.description: Show the error log (failed page fetches and PDF downloads). Use --retry to re-process them.

options.name: --retry
options.description: Re-download and re-index all PDFs in the error log. Clears each entry on success.
